customers.workspaceIntro: Tenant identity, deployment metadata, cohort, and environment flags. Mutations require customer.manage and server-side checks.
customers.metadataHint: Tenant metadata comes from the control-plane API and remains authoritative for operations.

customers.deleteTypeSlug: Type the customer slug "{{slug}}" to confirm
customers.suspendDone: "{{name}}" is suspended: its devices are refused from their next request.
customers.resumeDone: "{{name}}" is active again: its devices resume at their next licence check.

suspendDialog.title: Suspend this customer?
suspendDialog.body: Every device of "{{name}}" is refused from its next request. Licences, machines and data are kept; you can lift the suspension at any time.

resumeDialog.title: Lift the suspension?
resumeDialog.body: Devices of "{{name}}" may sync again; each fetches a fresh policy at its next licence check.

customers.listHint: Search, filter, sort, and select a customer before editing tenant-level settings.

customers.noResults: No customers match the current filters.
customers.selectTenantFirst: Select a customer row to view tenant metadata and policies.
customers.editDescription: Update tenant metadata. Slug changes must stay unique across all customers.
customers.addDescription: Create a new customer company. Fields are validated before sending to the control-plane API.
customers.confirmDeleteBody: This permanently deletes "{{name}}" ({{slug}}) and all associated license keys and activations. This cannot be undone.

validation.slugFormat: Use lowercase letters, numbers, and dashes only.
validation.slugLength: Slug must be between 3 and 64 characters.
validation.nameLength: Company name must be between 2 and 120 characters.
validation.cohortLength: Rollout cohort must be 64 characters or fewer.

policy.title: Force-update governance
policy.body: Enforce minimum desktop versions per tenant or cohort. Emergency mode blocks operations until clients update.
policy.selectTenant: Select a tenant to manage update governance.
policy.auditReason: Audit reason (kept in the audit log)
policy.minVersionHint: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, e.g. 1.8.0 ("2", "2.0" and "v2.0.0" also work). A pre-release build such as 0.4.0-dev counts as below 0.4.0. Leaving it empty keeps the current minimum version; "Remove minimum version" takes it off.
policy.userReason: Reason shown with the update prompt
policy.needReason: Enter an audit reason above to enable these actions (your authenticator code is asked when you apply).
policy.floorRemoved: Minimum version {{floor}} removed. Rolling back restores it.

removeFloorDialog.title: Remove the minimum version?
removeFloorDialog.tenantTarget: Removes the minimum version {{floor}} from the rule of customer {{name}}. The mode and the message shown to users stay as they are.
removeFloorDialog.cohortTarget: Removes the minimum version {{floor}} from the rule of rollout group {{cohort}} on channel {{channel}}: it covers every customer of this group that follows the group rule. The mode and the message shown to users stay as they are.

effect.emergency: Emergency mode stays on: every PC this rule covers stays blocked, whatever its version, until the mode is changed.
effect.required: Under "Required", a rule without a minimum version asks every PC to update, so it cannot be removed now. Switch the mode to Off first, then remove the minimum version.
effect.off: The mode is Off, so nothing changes for PCs now.
effect.inherit: This customer follows its rollout group's rule, so nothing changes for PCs now.

removeFloorDialog.rollbackNote: The rule before the change is kept: rolling back restores {{floor}}.

customers.completeBeforeAdding: Complete the following before adding this customer:

table.emptyBody: Add your first customer, then give them a licence key to activate their computers.

page.subtitle: Everyone using Maintafox, where they stand, and what to do next.

form.newBody: The customer gets a code used in their licence key. You can give them a licence right after.
form.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes, e.g. acme-industries. It cannot be reused by another customer.
form.cohortHint: Customers in the same group receive app updates together (stable-main unless you test with some).

editions.modulesHint: Read-only capability preset for this tenant. Desktop enforces module capabilities from the signed license envelope.
editions.pageBody: Manage license presets and module capability maps. Tenants pick an edition; newly issued keys stamp the current map.
editions.reissueBanner: Changes apply to keys issued after save. Re-issue a license (or re-activate) to refresh already-activated machines.
editions.editorHint: Send the full module map on save. System edition ids cannot be renamed or deleted.
editions.updated: Edition {{id}} saved. Re-issue keys to refresh activated machines.
editions.deleteBody: Delete {{id}}? This fails if any tenant (including inactive) still uses it.

machines.title: Machines & activation
machines.intro: Heartbeat visibility, trusted-device lifecycle, and offline-policy controls. Actions require step-up and server enforcement.
machines.fingerprintHint: Fingerprint confidence and rebind thresholds are evaluated server-side to limit unnecessary churn.
machines.revokeConfirm: Revoke this device? It is blocked within minutes and cannot reactivate itself with the licence key.
machines.reinstateConfirm: Reinstate this device? It needs a free slot on its licence.
machines.refreshRequested: Policy refresh requested: the device fetches its policy at its next licence check (its sync pauses until then).
machines.released: Slot released. The device is refused from its next request and may activate again later.
machines.rebound: Slot moved to {{fingerprint}}. The old device is refused; the new one activates with the licence key.

revoke.title: Revoke this device?
revoke.body: {{fingerprint}} is refused from its next request and cannot reactivate itself with the licence key (reinstate it here).

reinstate.title: Reinstate this device?
reinstate.body: {{fingerprint}} may sync again. It needs a free slot on its licence.

release.title: Release this slot?
release.body: {{fingerprint}} is refused from its next request and its slot becomes free. Unlike a revocation, the device may activate again later with the licence key.

rebind.title: Move this slot to a replacement machine?
rebind.body: {{fingerprint}} is refused at once. The replacement machine then activates with the licence key and finds its slot already held.
rebind.targetLabel: Fingerprint of the replacement machine (shown on its activation screen)

refresh.title: Ask this device to refresh its policy?
refresh.body: {{fingerprint}} fetches its licence, edition and policies at its next licence check instead of waiting for its schedule. Its sync pauses until then.

recovery.title: Give this PC an administrator recovery code?
recovery.body: Creates one new administrator account on {{fingerprint}} (valid 24 h, single use). Use it when the site can no longer administer this PC, for example when its only administrator forgot their password. The code is signed by Maintafox and works only on this PC:
recovery.pointOnce: It creates an EXTRA administrator: it does not reset or unlock an existing account. The customer disables the old account afterwards.
recovery.pointNotice: Every active administrator of the PC sees a persistent notice that a recovery code was used, until they acknowledge it.
recovery.pointExpiry: It is valid for 24 hours and can be used only once.
recovery.pointShownOnce: It is shown to you once; Maintafox does not keep it.
recovery.stillValid_one: {{count}} code issued earlier for this PC is still valid (until {{at}}).
recovery.stillValid_other: {{count}} codes issued earlier for this PC are still valid (until {{at}}).
recovery.requestedByLabel: Who asked at the customer (name and role)
recovery.identityCheckLabel: How you checked their identity against the customer's registered contact

identityCheck.callback_registered_phone: Called back on the registered phone number

recovery.identityNoteRequired: How the identity was checked (required, 5 to 200 characters)

machines.activationClaimHint: Use this to verify that the control-plane activation endpoint accepts a key + machine fingerprint.
machines.empty: No activated machines for this tenant yet.
machines.graceExtended: Offline grace window is now {{hours}} h.

extendGrace.title: Extend the offline grace window?
extendGrace.body: Devices of this customer may stay offline {{hours}} hours longer before they must reach the server.

toggleTrust.title: Change what a trust revocation does?
toggleTrust.body: Switches whether revoking a device’s trust disconnects it at once or at its next licence check.

sync.title: Sync operations
sync.body: Queues, replay, and repair windows. Requires sync.operate.
sync.pageBody: Lag, checkpoints, retries, and repair queues. Actions require sync.operate and server enforcement.

repair.title: Repair queue
repair.hint: Measured by the server. Refused items are replayed from the device itself (its Sync Center: the server keeps only their ids and reasons); a device whose copy is wrong can be fully resynchronised below.

drill.title: Failure drill-down
drill.empty: No failure rows for this tenant.

timeline.title: Device timeline
timeline.body: Everything the server recorded for one device: exchanges (and retries), refused items, conflicts, resynchronisations and operator actions on it.
timeline.noMachine: No activated machine for this customer.
timeline.resyncBody: At its next sync, {{machine}} is told its copy is out of date: it keeps its unsent changes, downloads all the data again, then sends them. Use it when the device's data looks wrong or incomplete.
timeline.resyncRequested: Resynchronisation requested: it starts at the device's next sync.
timeline.resyncOpen: Resynchronisation requested {{at}} by {{by}}: waiting for the device's next sync.

deletedAttachments.title: Deleted or replaced photos and attachments
deletedAttachments.body: The server keeps the deleted or replaced entry and the device that sent the change. Files uploaded to the server are never deleted. For an equipment, request or work order attachment, also restore its 'Photo or file' entry so devices download the file again. A file that was never uploaded (e.g. from a PC that was offline when it was deleted) cannot be recovered.
deletedAttachments.empty: No photo or attachment has been deleted or replaced by synchronisation.
deletedAttachments.restoreBody: {{id}}: version {{archived}}, kept {{at}}, replaces what the server has now: {{current}}. It is sent to every device of this customer; what it replaces is kept and can be restored too.
deletedAttachments.restored: Restored: {{id}} is sent to every device at their next sync.

file.notOnServer: No file copy on the server

companion.archived: Photo or file entry: {{id}} (deleted or replaced: restore it too)

prior.unknown: Unknown to the server: nothing kept

view.label: Show
view.nothing_kept: Deletes of items the server never held

nothingKept.summary_one: {{count}} delete of an item the server never held ({{type}}), from device {{device}}
nothingKept.summary_other: {{count}} deletes of items the server never held ({{type}}), from device {{device}}

sync.empty: No tenant sync telemetry available yet.

rollouts.title: Rollouts
rollouts.body: Publish and rollback control-plane artifacts. Requires rollout.manage and step-up.
rollouts.pageBody: Cohort staging, pause/recall, and integrated failure diagnostics. Recall requires step-up and server approval.

diagnostics.title: Release diagnostics (24h)
diagnostics.hint: Signature, migration, and post-deploy heartbeat failures in one view for containment decisions.

governance.deviceNotice: Pause and recall are recorded on the server, written to the audit log and sent to every device of the cohort with its policy. Desktops will act on them once the updater (master plan Phase 5) exists: today's desktops do not install updates by themselves, so nothing changes on them yet.

pause.title: Pause this rollout?
pause.body: {{cohort}}: devices stop being offered new updates until you resume.

resume.title: Resume this rollout?
resume.body: {{cohort}}: devices are offered updates again (a recall is lifted too).

recall.title: Recall a version?
recall.body: {{cohort}}: the version below is withdrawn; devices running it are told to leave it.

health.title: Platform health
health.body: SLOs, integration status, and worker reliability (read-only observe surface).
health.pageBody: Unified telemetry across services, infrastructure pressure, and alert ownership. Drill-through stays tenant-safe.

pressure.title: Infrastructure pressure
pressure.hint: Trend and threshold hints for operators; authoritative thresholds live server-side.

drill.title: Related operational views
drill.body: Tenant-safe incident drill-through links curated views in sync and rollout workspaces without exposing unrelated customer data.

alerts.title: Alerts & ownership
alerts.hint: Alerts are read from control-plane telemetry with tenant-safe drill-through references.
alerts.readOnly: Handled by upstream alerting workflow; this panel is read-only.

audit.title: Audit & evidence
audit.body: Structured audit retrieval with correlation id drill-through.
audit.pageBody: Immutable audit trail, support workflows, and operational safeguards. Requires audit.view; mutations are enforced server-side.

ledger.intro: Append-only ledger with per-record integrity hash and hash-chain linkage. Server persists and verifies.

detail.title: Audit record
detail.severityNotProvided: Not provided by the audit API for a single record.

ledger.empty: No audit records for this filter.

support.intro: Structured tickets, diagnostic bundles with redaction, offline reconciliation, and explicit links to audit records.

tickets.title: Tickets
tickets.noteTooShort: The intervention note needs at least 3 characters.

bundle.title: Diagnostic bundles
bundle.empty: No diagnostic bundle has been uploaded by a desktop yet.
bundle.downloadStarted: Download of diagnostic bundle {{id}} started (recorded as {{record}}).

newTicket.title: Open a ticket
newTicket.incomplete: Choose a customer and fill in the module (2+ characters) and the summary (3+ characters).

harden.intro: Privileged actions require reason codes and step-up; high-blast-radius may require dual approval on the server.

guards.title: Privileged-action safeguards
guards.body: The server refuses these actions without a reason and a fresh code from the authenticator app, valid for that kind of action only; every attempt is in the audit log.
guards.kindsAria: Actions that need a fresh authenticator code

stepUp.title: Confirm sensitive action
stepUp.description: A fresh code from your authenticator app is required to {{action}}. The server then allows this kind of action for 5 minutes.
stepUp.errorRateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
stepUp.cancelled: Action cancelled: confirmation was not completed.
stepUp.errorInvalidCode: Code refused. Check the phone's time, or wait for the next code (a code works only once).

kinds.entitlement_suspension: revoke a licence or suspend a customer
kinds.forced_rollback: roll back an update policy or recall a rollout
kinds.rollout_publish: set an update policy, pause or resume a rollout
kinds.machine_trust_change: revoke, reinstate, release or rebind a machine
kinds.sync_repair: replay or repair a device's synchronisation
kinds.vendor_user_admin: change a console operator or reset their two-step verification
kinds.tenant_delete: delete a customer and all its data
kinds.admin_recovery_code: give a PC a code that creates a new administrator
kinds.sync_attachment_restore: restore a photo or attachment deleted by synchronisation

logoutAll.title: Log out of every browser?
logoutAll.body: Every session of your account ends now, on every computer (use it after losing a laptop or if you suspect someone used your account). You will sign in again with your password and a code.

regenerate.title: Generate new recovery codes
regenerate.body: Your current recovery codes stop working. You will see 10 new ones once: save them away from your phone.

codes.title: Your new recovery codes
codes.body: Each code works once, if you lose your authenticator app. They are shown only now: print them or save them somewhere safe.

password.title: Change your password
password.body: At least {{min}} characters. Your other sessions end; this one continues.

operators.title: Console operators
operators.body: Who can sign in to this console and what they may do. The server checks each operator's role on every request; every change here asks for a reason and a fresh authenticator code and is written to the audit log.

roleHelp.operations: customers, licences, machines, rollouts, sync and support; cannot manage operators.
roleHelp.support: support tickets and diagnostic bundles, sync repair; reads the rest.
roleHelp.auditor: reads the audit log and platform health; changes nothing.

form.name: Name
form.password: Initial password (at least {{min}} characters; give it to them yourself)

done.disabled: {{email}} is disabled: their sessions ended and they cannot sign in.
done.deleted: {{email}} was deleted (the audit log keeps their actions).

create.title: Add an operator
create.body: They sign in with this email and password, then set up their own authenticator app with the one-time code shown next.

role.title: Change role?
role.body: {{email}} becomes {{role}}. It applies to their next request.

disable.title: Disable this operator?
disable.body: {{email}} is signed out everywhere and cannot sign in until enabled again. The account and its audit trail are kept.

mfaReset.title: Reset two-step verification?
mfaReset.body: {{email}}'s authenticator and recovery codes stop working and they are signed out. Their next sign-in needs the one-time reset code shown next, then a new enrolment.

delete.title: Delete this operator?
delete.body: {{email}} is signed out and deleted. Their past actions stay in the audit log.

enrolment.title: One-time enrolment code
enrolment.body: Give this code to {{email}} with their password (not by the same channel if you can). Their first sign-in asks for it before they set up their authenticator. It is shown only now.

reset.title: One-time reset code
reset.body: Give this code to {{email}}. Their next sign-in asks for it, then they set up their authenticator again. It is shown only now.

billing.title: Billing and subscription
billing.body: Licence term and slots, and every payment exactly as recorded. "Check with SlickPay" asks SlickPay for the real status: a payment is applied only when SlickPay says it is paid; nothing here marks a payment as paid by hand.
billing.noLicence: No licence for this customer yet.
billing.slickpayOff: SlickPay is not configured on the server: payment links and checks with SlickPay are unavailable (deploy/BILLING.md).
billing.openOrders_one: {{count}} payment is not settled yet: check it with SlickPay if the customer says they paid.
billing.openOrders_other: {{count}} payments are not settled yet: check them with SlickPay if the customer says they paid.
billing.manualExtension: Extend or add slots by hand (Entitlements)

reconcile.title: Check this payment with SlickPay?
reconcile.body: The server asks SlickPay for the status of invoice {{invoice}}. If SlickPay says it is paid and it was not applied (lost notification), the licence is renewed now, exactly as for a normal payment. Nothing else changes.

outcome.applied: SlickPay says paid: the payment is now applied and the licence renewed.
outcome.license_revoked: SlickPay says paid, but the licence is revoked: the payment was not applied (order marked failed).
outcome.issue_failed: SlickPay says paid, but the licence could not be renewed: see the audit log.
outcome.mismatch_paid_here_not_at_slickpay: Recorded as paid here, but SlickPay now says "{{slickpay}}". Nothing was undone: check with SlickPay and the customer.

link.title: Create a SlickPay payment link
link.body: SlickPay creates an invoice for this customer; send them the link. When they pay, the licence is renewed for one year and the extra slots are added. Extra slot price: {{price}} each.
link.bodyNoSlotPrice: SlickPay creates an invoice for this customer; send them the link. When they pay, the licence is renewed for one year. Extra slots need SLICKPAY_EXTRA_SLOT_PRICE on the server.
link.created: Payment link created ({{amount}} {{currency}}): send it to the customer.

device_not_syncing.title_other: A device has not synced for {{count}} days

sync.noAccess: Your role does not include sync operations.

support.noFiles: No diagnostic file received from this customer.
support.goToSupport: Go to Support to download or answer

devices.subtitle: Every desktop activated with a licence, what it is doing, and what you can do about it.

action.moveSeat: Move the seat to a new computer
action.refresh: Ask it to refresh its licence now

recoveryCode.issuedBody: Send this code to the site of {{name}} by email or chat. Someone at that PC enters it in the Maintafox desktop (administrator recovery) to create one new administrator account; existing accounts are not changed.
recoveryCode.copyFailed: Could not copy automatically: select the code and copy it by hand.
recoveryCode.shownOnce: It is shown only this once: Maintafox does not keep it. Copy it now. If it is lost, issue a new one.

offline.title: Offline rules
offline.body: How long the computers of this customer may work without reaching the server, and what blocking one does.
offline.reconnect: Must check in before working again

test.body: Checks that a licence key and a computer fingerprint are accepted. It is a real activation: the computer takes a seat (free it again in Devices).

sysHealth.lastBackupFailed: The run of {{at}} failed; the date above is the last one that worked.
sysHealth.onlyOnServer: All copies are on this server only. Add a copy on a computer in your office (backup pull) to be safe if the server is lost.
sysHealth.offsiteFailed: The off-site copy failed: only the copies on this server are up to date.
